prompt: My wife left me,  I have never been single since I was living with my parents.   What do I do now?  Where can I turn too? (I am not mentally ill in any way)
response: It's natural to feel overwhelmed after losing a spouse. You can start by reaching out to a support group for single adults for advice and community. You might also consider contacting local social services or a counseling center, as they can offer guidance and resources.
